name: GlzSwitch
semanticRole: Toggle an immediately applied binary setting whose current on/off state remains visible and reversible.

material.rule: The switch control itself stays solid and tactile. Use it only for immediate settings; deferred form choices use Checkbox instead.

input.keyboard: Space toggles the focused switch; Enter may toggle where platform convention supports it; activation applies state immediately.
input.focus: Visible focus surrounds the full target and remains distinct from the on/off state.
input.hover: Hover may strengthen track/thumb definition but never communicates state by itself.
input.press: Thumb/track feedback begins immediately and follows direct manipulation where drag-to-toggle is supported.
input.selection: On/off state uses thumb position plus programmatic checked state and optional semantic icon, not color alone.
input.directManipulation: If dragging is supported, the thumb tracks the pointer/finger continuously and settles to a valid binary state on release.

accessibility.name: A persistent visible setting label supplies the accessible name; optional description explains consequences.
accessibility.state: Checked/on, unchecked/off, disabled, and invalid/error state where meaningful are programmatically exposed.
accessibility.value: Boolean checked state is the semantic value; visual thumb position never substitutes for it.
accessibility.keyboard: Space toggles reliably without requiring drag or pointer precision.
accessibility.focus: Focus is visible independently from the checked state and remains legible in forced colors.
accessibility.errorAssociation: If immediate application fails, associate the error/status message with the setting and restore or explain authoritative state.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Thumb movement becomes short restrained glide or direct state change while preserving position meaning.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: No functional change required because the switch is solid by default.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen track/thumb boundary, focus, and on/off distinction.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use platform switch/checkbox semantics or system colors with position and checked state preserved.
accessibility.largeText: Label and description reflow; switch remains aligned to the logical setting row without reducing target size.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Short restrained thumb glide or direct state change.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Platform checked-state semantics and system colors.
fallbacks.performance: No blur/material dependency; simplify optional shadow only.

content.overflow: Labels/descriptions wrap; the switch remains reachable and does not overlap text at narrow widths.
content.localization: Setting labels and descriptions tolerate 30–50% expansion and locale-specific sentence structure.
content.rtl: Setting row alignment follows direction; logical off/on thumb positions mirror with platform convention.

criteria: On/off state is readable from position and structure before color.
Thumb movement feels connected to direct manipulation without bounce or lag.
Long labels do not force the switch into an ambiguous detached position.
Error/application-failure feedback does not falsely show a state the producer rejected.
